innovation_summary: qwen-vl-flash-router is a routing specialist for fast multimodal Qwen-VL requests, choosing a target model under joint latency, modality, and model-selection constraints — a dispatch layer that decides whether an image-plus-text request needs the full vision-language model or can be served by a cheaper flash path. Its portfolio thesis is that multimodal serving cost is dominated by over-routing: sending every request to the heaviest capable model. It is the canonical head of a four-repository Qwen family in which the other three are all reference-only upstream material, so its explicit job in the estate is to be the authored boundary marker — the recorded family priority is 'P1 router proof and reference boundary', meaning the router must be provably original work sitting in front of vendored Qwen code.
